description: This file defines a function 'aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost' that aggregates agent costs and usage data from MongoDB collections 'session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'. It processes various data structures, normalizes currency strings, applies filters, and merges results to produce a summarized report of agent usage and costs.

methods.name: toNumberSafe
methods.description: A helper function that safely converts currency-like strings (e.g., '$0.108255') or other inputs into numeric values.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost
methods.description: Main function that queries and aggregates agent cost and usage data from MongoDB collections, applying filters and merging results to produce a summarized report.
